description: Fetch a Eurostat dataset's metadata: dimensions with sample values, time range, observation count and last update. Call it before eurostat_query_dataset or eurostat_download_dataset to learn the dimension codes their filters take; the download rejects a filter naming a dimension absent here. Up to 10 sample values per dimension; eurostat_get_dimension_values lists the rest. A DS-* code (detailed trade and PRODCOM, any case) is read from the Comext host, which reports no period coverage or observation count; the first call on a large Comext collection downloads its full structure and takes longer, and repeat calls within the hour reuse it.

dataset_code.description: Dataset code (e.g., "nama_10_gdp", or "DS-045409" for a Comext collection), from eurostat_search_datasets or eurostat_browse_themes.

name: eurostat_get_dataset_info

items.description: A dataset dimension with its valid values.

code.description: Dimension code (e.g., "geo"), the filter key in eurostat_query_dataset and eurostat_download_dataset.

sampleValues.description: The first 10 values; eurostat_get_dimension_values lists all. Omitted alongside valuesCount.

items.description: A dimension value code and label pair.

valuesCount.description: Values the dataset carries in this dimension; for "time", its period count. Omitted when Eurostat supplies no measurable value set.

error.description: Present when the call failed. Absent on success.

code.description: JSON-RPC error code for this failure.

reason.description: Machine-readable failure mode. Declared by this tool: `not_found`: The dataset code does not exist or is not disseminated. `upstream_fault`: Eurostat returned a dataset structure this server cannot read, or refused the structure read, which is not retried; marked retryable when the structure endpoint failed or could not be reached on every retry. Other values are possible when a failure originates below the handler.

recovery.description: Actionable next step for the caller.

message.description: Human-readable description of what went wrong.

lastUpdated.description: ISO 8601 timestamp of the last data update; omitted when not reported.

metadataUrl.description: ESMS metadata page URL; omitted when Eurostat gives none.

obsCount.description: Observations across the whole dataset; omitted when not reported, which means unknown, not zero.

timeRange.description: Dataset coverage. An omitted bound is unknown, not empty.

end.description: Latest period (e.g., "2024"); omitted when not reported.

start.description: Earliest period (e.g., "1975"); omitted when not reported.

title: Get Eurostat Dataset Info
